messages:
Alex P: Quick async standup — what I did: finished the regional headroom telemetry patch and rolled a small fix to the capacity estimator. Noticed eu-west1 headroom dropping ~12% during the 03:00 UTC spike.
Marta S: blockers: APAC spot churn still noisy, saw 3 spot evictions in ap-southeast1 overnight causing queues to back up. Need a short runway for the canary.
Ryan L: today: I can prewarm 2 gpus in eu-west1 for the canary, but need a temporary quota bump (INFRA-3421). Can someone approve a 4-hour reserve?
Jamie (sre): approved for 2 A100s for 2h, pending cost signoff. If you want 4 we need finance ok. @Marta S can you add the cost delta to the ticket? :money_with_wings:
Marta S: on it. Adding estimates now. Also adding a note: KV-cache priming jobs should run before the canary to avoid first-token latency spikes.
Alex P: good call. Ryan, run the priming job with this snippet before traffic:

```
rwi priming run --region eu-west1 --model rdx-small --concurrency 8 --prefixes primeset-v2
kubectl logs -l app=priming-job -n infra --tail 50
```

Ryan L: running priming at 10:20 UTC. Also pinging compute quota team for the bump.
Infra-bot: [deploy] capacity-estimator v1.3 rolled to canary in eu-west1 by alexp — ID deploy-cc-883.
Kevin D: FYI re: ap-southeast1 spot churn — started a soft-eviction mitigation that shifts 20% of scheduled warm requests to on-demand pool when eviction rate > 1.8%. Will monitor.
Marta S: blocker update: if on-demand spillover triggers, we may exceed burst budget; asking product to gate heavy logs during the 2h window. @Jamie (sre) any objections?
Jamie (sre): fine. we'll enable log-sampling at the route level for that period. Also set a rollback window in case latency creeps.
Alex P: small CR ping — left comments on infra/estimator#128 about the smoothing window. Ryan, can you take a quick look? It's tiny.
Ryan L: will review in 15. If green, I'll trigger the quota request and then kick the priming job.
Marta S: last note — eu-west1 metrics dashboard now has a new panel for spillover ratio. Link: https://grafana.redwood/example/d/evictions.
Alex P: thanks all. If anyone sees headroom <10% after priming, escalate in this thread and tag @jamie.
Kevin D: will report back in 30m with spot/ondemand mix stats. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
